  • Leave Policy

    • Leave Policy — governed values

    One stored value, two faces (POL-5) · resolution precedence: personal deviation ▸ campus tweak ▸ group master — nearest wins; fixed floors bind everything (POL-4/11)

    Casual leave days — “says who?”
    .fh-source — specificity reads as intensity
    Group master 10 days Group master changeable · head-office routed (POL-8)
    FSNC campus tweak 12 days Overridden at FSNC approved head office · 12 Mar 2026
    Retention agreement +2 days Personal deviation on the employment record (POL-11) — never on the policy page
    Maternity minimum 26 weeks Fixed — statutory floor no campus tweak, no private agreement crosses it (POL-1/11)
    What does Meera get? — .fh-resolve
    acceptance §17.4: same master sentence, each campus’s number
    Meera · FWGS
    Group master 10 days nearest layer with a value
    FWGS tweak — none
    Personal deviation — none
    Resolved 10 days the number on her policy page
    Her colleague · FSNC

    Bounded value — .fh-bounds
    0allowed 0–15 · Bounded (A2)20
    campus-approvable (POL-8) — an ordinary operational value, visible to head office
    020
    clamped to the bound — overrides are always clamped, never rejected silently
    Policy versions — .fh-validity
    “what was the rule on 15 March?”
    as of 09 Jul 2026
    v1 01 Apr 2024 – 31 Mar 2026
    v2 — in force 01 Apr 2026 – 31 Mar 2027
    v3 — future 01 Apr 2027 →

    future-dated is normal — approved today, effective 1 April, visible in advance; backdating is a governed exception (POL-15). A published version is immutable — a changed rule is a new version.

    Statutory bundle — with a correction lane
    FY25 bundle Apr 2025 – Mar 2026
    FY26 bundle · r2 Apr 2026 →
    FY26 bundle · r1 superseded 15 May 2026 — preserved, never edited
    the correction lane pairs with 38 LOCK’s superseded treatment — deltas pay forward as labelled arrears

    One vocabulary for every governed value: payroll’s baseline→org→entity→employee chain, HR config’s locked-vs-open rows, POL’s master ▸ tweak ▸ resolved view, fees’ most-specific-wins pricing. The chips/marks are the language — resolution itself is the consumer’s service (POL-4), never CSS.
